data.name: Basheesh
data.gender_notes: Basheesh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: A giver of good news, or a healer
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Basheesh is derived from the root 'Bashara', which means to give good news or to heal. In Islamic history, Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) was given the news of his son Ismail's birth when he was old, and this child became the source of blessings for him. Thus, Basheesh symbolizes the joy of receiving good news, or the healing power of Allah (SWT).
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope, joy, and healing
data.etymology: Basheesh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A giver of good news, or a healer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basheesh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_urdu.name: بشیش
in_urdu.meaning: معنى: وہ جو خوشخبری دینے اورتشویق کرنے اور دعاء کرنے والا ہو، جو خوشی اور امان کا باعث ہو، جو مسلمانوں کے لیے مثالی ہو، اور جو ان کی رہنمائی کرتا ہو
in_urdu.long_meaning: بشیش کو خوشخبری دینا اور امان دینا ہے۔ یہ ایک خوشی اور امان کی علامت ہے جو مسلمانوں کے لیے مثالی ہے۔ بشیش کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ شخص جو خوشی اور امان کی راہ میں ہے اور جو مسلمانوں کے لیے مثالی ہے۔ یہ ایک ایسی شخصیت ہے جو خوشی اور امان کی راہ میں ہے اور جو مسلمانوں کے لیے مثالی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बशिश
in_hindi.meaning: अर्थ: जो खुशखबरी देता है, जो आश्वासन देता है, जो प्रार्थना करता है, जो खुशी और शांति का कारण है, जो मुसलमानों के लिए आदर्श है, जो उनकी राहنمाई करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: बशिश का अर्थ है खुशखबरी देना और आश्वासन देना। यह एक खुशी और शांति की भावना है जो मुसलमानों के लिए आदर्श है। बशिश मुसलमानों के लिए एक आदर्श व्यक्ति है जो उन्हें सही राह पर मार्गदर्शन करता है। यह एक ऐसी भावना है जो मुसलमानों को خوشी और शांति का अनुभव कराती है।

in_pashto.name: بشیش
in_pashto.meaning: معنى: د بشيش يوړونکی، د خوشخبري ښودونکی، د پریماني ښودونکی، د اماني ښودونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د بشيش يوړونکی څوک دی چې خوشخبری ورکوي او امان ورکوي. دا پریماني ښودونکی دی چې مسلمانانو ته یوړونکی دی. دا دا وخت کیږي چې مسلمانانو ته یوړونکی دی.

historical_references.reference: The name 'Basheesh' is derived from the Arabic word 'Bashar', which means 'man' or 'human'. In early Islamic history, it was used as a title for physicians and healers. The title signified their ability to cure human ailments and bring comfort to those in need.
historical_references.context: During the early Islamic period, medicine was highly regarded and physicians held a respected position in society. The title 'Basheesh' was a mark of distinction for these professionals.

historical_references.reference: Later, during the Ottoman Empire, the title 'Basheesh' was used for tax farmers. These individuals were granted the right to collect taxes in a specific region for a set period of time in exchange for a lump sum payment. The term 'Basheesh' signified a broker or intermediary between the government and the people, and was used to distinguish tax farmers from other officials and administrators.
historical_references.context: The Ottoman Empire relied on tax farming as a means of revenue collection. The title 'Basheesh' was used to differentiate tax farmers from other government officials and to acknowledge their role as intermediaries in the tax collection process.
